role: Operational runbook for responding to an App Store rejection, listing the most likely guideline triggers and the fix/appeal/resubmit sequence.

units.does: no behavioural claim: runbook title and trigger (~14 days to respond).

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > 1. Read the actual reason
units.does: Lists likely rejection causes with code pointers: PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy + SECURITY.md alignment section; UIBackgroundModes location/bluetooth-peripheral/audio, naming WorkoutLocationManager (workout route) and BreadcrumbRecorder (Get Me Back trail) as the two background-location streamers, both with the location indicator, and BackgroundAudioManager holding audio only during a cue; MedicalQueryGuard and the MEDICAL BOUNDARY block in AIProvider+SystemPromptText.swift; docs/REVIEW.md reviewer notes.

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > 2. Reproduce the rejection trigger locally
units.does: no behavioural claim: process advice to reproduce the rejection locally.

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > 3. Decide: fix-and-resubmit OR appeal
units.does: no behavioural claim: process for fix-and-resubmit (bump CFBundleVersion, attach build) vs appeal.

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > 4. Resubmit
units.does: no behavioural claim: attach new build to open submission.

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > 5. Record the cause and the fix
units.does: no behavioural claim: record cause in notes outside the repo.

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > Common gotchas
units.does: no behavioural claim: App Store Connect gotchas (build replacement, processing lag, CFBundleVersion collisions).

units.key: § Runbook: App Store Rejection Response > Contacts
units.does: no behavioural claim: Apple contact links.
